question: Which CET bids are due within 30 days?
html:
Two CET bids in the data fall due by December 2, 2026. They are the Cambridge neighborhood EV charging bid (Nov 10, 2026) and the MassWildlife Roger Reed Hatchery generators and ATS bid (Nov 25, 2026). Both come from a radar dated Sep 24, 2026, so the dates need a live check.

Due within 30 days

BidDueDays leftNotes
Cambridge neighborhood EV chargingNov 10, 20268Federal-aid. Radar flags MassDOT prequalification and DBE requirements to check now.
MassWildlife Roger Reed Hatchery generators and ATSNov 25, 202623Part of the radar's single crew plan for fast-turn generator and UPS jobs.

Source: (CET opportunity radar).

Nothing near-term in public bids

  • None of the six COMMBUYS listings closes before June 30, 2027 (New England public bids).
  • The nearest are two Department of Energy Resources solar and decarbonization grant programs, due June 30, 2027.
  • The Department of Correction generator bid and the two MEP statewide contracts close between Dec 11, 2027 and Jan 31, 2035. That pattern suggests standing contract vehicles rather than discrete jobs (est.).
  • The federal awards feed shows contracts already awarded, not open bids. It does not answer this question (Federal trade-contractor awards).

October deadlines now passed

The radar listed several October bids, and all of those dates have passed:

  • Massport Worcester 149A trade-contractor RFQ (Oct 8)
  • WRA Union Station generator (Oct 28)
  • BPS and Campbell Resource Center generators (Oct 8)
  • LRTA 250 kW generator (Oct 6)
  • SRTA New Bedford DCFC (Oct 9)
  • CT River Road and Glastonbury bids (Oct 15, Oct 6)
  • MassDOT NEVI installer call (open to Oct 31)

Whether CET submitted any of these is not in the context. A CET bid log with submission status would answer that.

Coverage gaps

  • The radar is about six weeks old. It holds 86 items, but only three are itemized here, and its action list is cut off at item six. Other bids due in the window may exist (CET opportunity radar).
  • Automated access to COMMBUYS, CTsource/BizNet, RI Purchasing and NH DAS was blocked. Open bids in those portals may be missing (CET opportunity radar).
  • The MassDEP 2026 CWSRF list is not itemized. It covers 76 projects worth about $1.02B and needs a manual pull (CET opportunity radar).

Next actions

  1. Confirm the Cambridge EV charging due date and addenda today. Check MassDOT prequalification and DBE status, given eight days left.
  2. Lock the Roger Reed Hatchery generator and ATS bid team and pricing schedule. Target internal sign-off one week before Nov 25, 2026.
  3. Refresh the radar, with a manual pull of COMMBUYS, CTsource, RI and NH portals, to catch any other bids due by December 2, 2026.
  4. Record submit and no-bid status for the October items. Follow up on award results where CET bid.
